summary: HPS Real Assets Lending Company LP filed a Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership interests across Series I and Series II, with final share counts set September 28, 2026. Gross proceeds approximate $10.8 million from roughly 1.16 million shares, priced off a September 28 transactional NAV of $25.46 (Series I) and $25.52 (Series II). The manager also declared per-class monthly distributions combining regular and variable supplemental amounts. Offers relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S exemptions. This is an ordinary private-placement capital-raising and distribution notice, not a special situation; watch for continued NAV-based issuance pace.
